summary: Whether you show it or not, a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you draw people in and know what you want and you reach, grow, and lift the room. At the edge, you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it.
body: Whether you show it or not, a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you draw people in and know what you want and you reach, grow, and lift the room. At the edge, you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it. Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
gift: At your best: you draw people in and know what you want, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it — or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let love and values and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you draw people in and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
